---
title: "Integração Mobile (Deep Link)"
---

## Objetivo

Implementar verificação de credenciais rurais em um **app React Native (Expo)** usando Deep Link — o app abre a Carteira Digital diretamente no dispositivo (fluxo same-device).

## Fluxo Mobile

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as Usuário
    participant App as App React Native
    participant VS as INJI Verify Service
    participant W as INJI Wallet

    U->>App: Toca "Verificar documentos e solicitar crédito"
    App->>VS: POST /v1/verify/vp-request
    VS-->>App: transactionId + requestId + requestUri
    App->>W: Linking.openURL("openid4vp://authorize?...")
    Note over W: Usuário autoriza credenciais
    W->>VS: POST /v1/verify/vp-submission (direct_post)
    App->>App: AppState "active" → retoma polling
    App->>VS: GET /v1/verify/vp-request/{requestId}/status
    VS-->>App: VP_SUBMITTED
    App->>VS: GET /v1/verify/vp-result/{transactionId}
    VS-->>App: { vpResultStatus: "SUCCESS", vcResults: [...] }
    App->>U: "Crédito pré-aprovado!"
```

## Pré-requisitos

- Expo SDK 51+ com `expo-linking`
- `scheme` configurado no `app.json` (necessário para o wallet retornar ao app)
- INJI Wallet instalado no dispositivo para testes

## Passo 1 — Criar o serviço de verificação

```ts
// src/services/verifyService.ts
import { Linking } from "react-native";

const BASE_URL = "https://<VERIFY_BASE_URL>";
const CLIENT_ID = "did:web:<SEU_DOMINIO>:v1:verify";
const ORIGIN = "<seu-app>://";

const PRESENTATION_DEFINITION = {
  id: "imovel-rural-check",
  input_descriptors: [
    {
      id: "CCIRCredential",
      name: "CCIR - Certificado de Cadastro",
      purpose: "Verificar cadastro do imóvel rural (CCIR)",
      constraints: {
        fields: [
          {
            path: ["$.type"],
            filter: { type: "string", pattern: "CCIRCredential" },
          },
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      id: "CARReceipt",
      name: "CAR - Recibo de Inscrição",
      purpose: "Verificar inscrição do imóvel no CAR",
      constraints: {
        fields: [
          {
            path: ["$.type"],
            filter: { type: "string", pattern: "CARReceipt" },
          },
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      id: "CARDocument",
      name: "CAR - Documento",
      purpose: "Verificar documento do imóvel no CAR",
      constraints: {
        fields: [
          {
            path: ["$.type"],
            filter: { type: "string", pattern: "CARDocument" },
          },
        ],
      },
    },
  ],
};

export async function createVPRequest(singleCredentialId?: string): Promise<{
  transactionId: string;
  requestId: string;
  deepLinkUrl: string;
}> {
  const presentationDef = singleCredentialId
    ? {
        id: PRESENTATION_DEFINITION.id,
        input_descriptors: PRESENTATION_DEFINITION.input_descriptors.filter(
          (d) => d.id === singleCredentialId
        ),
      }
    : PRESENTATION_DEFINITION;

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/v1/verify/vp-request`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ clientId: CLIENT_ID, presentationDefinition: presentationDef }),
  });

  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Falha ao criar VP request (${response.status})`);

  const data = await response.json();

  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  params.set("client_id", CLIENT_ID);
  params.set("request_uri", data.requestUri);
  params.set("origin", ORIGIN);

  return {
    transactionId: data.transactionId,
    requestId: data.requestId,
    deepLinkUrl: `openid4vp://authorize?${params.toString()}`,
  };
}

export async function pollVPStatus(
  requestId: string
): Promise<"ACTIVE" | "VP_SUBMITTED" | "EXPIRED"> {
  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/v1/verify/vp-request/${requestId}/status`);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Erro ao buscar status: ${response.status}`);
  const data = await response.json();
  return data.status;
}

export async function getVPResult(
  transactionId: string
): Promise<{ verified: boolean; credentials: any[] }> {
  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/v1/verify/vp-result/${transactionId}`);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Erro ao buscar resultado: ${response.status}`);

  const data = await response.json();

  if (data.vpResultStatus !== "SUCCESS" || !data.vcResults?.length) {
    throw new Error(`Resultado indisponível: status=${data.vpResultStatus}`);
  }

  const credentials = data.vcResults.map((r: any) => {
    try {
      return typeof r.vc === "string" ? JSON.parse(r.vc) : r.vc;
    } catch {
      return r.vc;
    }
  });

  return { verified: true, credentials };
}

export async function openWalletForVerification(
  singleCredentialId?: string
): Promise<{ transactionId: string; requestId: string }> {
  const { transactionId, requestId, deepLinkUrl } = await createVPRequest(singleCredentialId);

  try {
    await Linking.openURL(deepLinkUrl);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Nenhum wallet compatível encontrado. Instale o INJI Wallet.");
  }

  return { transactionId, requestId };
}
```

## Passo 2 — Tela de verificação

O ponto crítico do fluxo mobile é detectar quando o usuário **volta ao app** após autorizar na carteira. Use `AppState` e `AsyncStorage` para isso:

```tsx
// src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import { View, Text, Pressable, AppState } from "react-native";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";
import { openWalletForVerification, pollVPStatus, getVPResult } from "../services/verifyService";

const PENDING_POLL_KEY = "credme_pending_poll";

type Status = "idle" | "loading" | "waiting" | "success" | "error";

export default function HomeScreen() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>("idle");
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState("");
  const [credentials, setCredentials] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const pollRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  const startPolling = (transactionId: string, requestId: string) => {
    if (pollRef.current) clearInterval(pollRef.current);
    setStatus("waiting");

    const checkStatus = async () => {
      try {
        const vpStatus = await pollVPStatus(requestId);
        if (vpStatus === "VP_SUBMITTED") {
          clearInterval(pollRef.current!);
          pollRef.current = null;
          await AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_POLL_KEY);
          const result = await getVPResult(transactionId);
          setCredentials(result.credentials);
          setStatus("success");
        } else if (vpStatus === "EXPIRED") {
          clearInterval(pollRef.current!);
          pollRef.current = null;
          await AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_POLL_KEY);
          setErrorMsg("Solicitação expirada. Tente novamente.");
          setStatus("error");
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        console.warn("Poll error:", e?.message);
      }
    };

    checkStatus();
    pollRef.current = setInterval(checkStatus, 3000);
  };

  // Restaura polling pendente ao voltar ao foreground
  useEffect(() => {
    const restorePoll = () => {
      AsyncStorage.getItem(PENDING_POLL_KEY).then((saved) => {
        if (!saved) return;
        try {
          const { transactionId, requestId } = JSON.parse(saved);
          if (transactionId && requestId && !pollRef.current)
            startPolling(transactionId, requestId);
        } catch {
          AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_POLL_KEY);
        }
      });
    };

    restorePoll();

    const appStateSub = AppState.addEventListener("change", (state) => {
      if (state === "active") restorePoll();
    });

    return () => {
      appStateSub.remove();
      if (pollRef.current) clearInterval(pollRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleRequest = async (singleCredentialId?: string) => {
    setStatus("loading");
    setErrorMsg("");
    setCredentials([]);

    try {
      const { transactionId, requestId } = await openWalletForVerification(singleCredentialId);
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(PENDING_POLL_KEY, JSON.stringify({ transactionId, requestId }));
      startPolling(transactionId, requestId);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErrorMsg(e?.message || "Erro ao solicitar credenciais.");
      setStatus("error");
    }
  };

  const reset = () => {
    if (pollRef.current) clearInterval(pollRef.current);
    AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_POLL_KEY);
    setStatus("idle");
    setCredentials([]);
    setErrorMsg("");
  };

  return (
    <View>
      {status === "idle" && (
        <Pressable onPress={() => handleRequest()}>
          <Text>Verificar documentos e solicitar crédito</Text>
        </Pressable>
      )}
      {status === "loading" && <Text>Conectando...</Text>}
      {status === "waiting" && <Text>Aguardando autorização na carteira...</Text>}
      {status === "success" && (
        <View>
          <Text>✅ {credentials.length} credencial(is) verificada(s)!</Text>
          <Pressable onPress={reset}><Text>Nova solicitação</Text></Pressable>
        </View>
      )}
      {status === "error" && (
        <View>
          <Text>⚠️ {errorMsg}</Text>
          <Pressable onPress={reset}><Text>Tentar novamente</Text></Pressable>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}
```

## Verificação individual por credencial

Para verificar uma credencial por vez, passe o `id` do `input_descriptor`:

```tsx
// Verificar apenas o CCIR
handleRequest("CCIRCredential");

// Verificar apenas o Recibo CAR
handleRequest("CARReceipt");

// Verificar apenas o CAR Document
handleRequest("CARDocument");
```
